newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-FOREKS SAYS NO NEED TO MERGE.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-FOREKS SAYS NO NEED TO MERGE.

text.p: The strategy of Forekspank does not foresee any mergers with other commercial banks as it has no direct need for it, the bank said on Tuesday.
Hoiupank said earlier it was interested in merging with a smaller local bank, adding it has a "bigger interest" towards Forekspank as an effective financial company.
"Forekspank has no need to merge and our strategy does not foresee any mergers," board member Ranno Pajuri told Reuters.
"The Forekspank board has not discussed it (a merger) and we have not received...any official document," he added.
Pajuri added that at the same time there was a trend for consolidation in Estonia's financial sphere and companies were looking for strategic partners.
Pajuri also said that two bank have different strategies.
"Hoiupank is the largest individual deposit keeper while Forekspank has put its main emphasis on serving corporate clients," he said.
Forekspank is the fifth largest of Estonia's banks with total assets of 1.8 billion kroons. Hoiupank's assets were 6.2 billion kroons at the end of May.
